response.original_title: Crossroads. El viaje circular de Boa Mistura
response.overview: The Madrid-born art collective Boa Mistura travels across continents, collaborating with local communities to transform public spaces through colour and collective painting. Beginning in Cape Town, this documentary connects encounters in Brazil, Kenya, Chile and the Dominican Republic, exploring art as a tool for social change.
